uncertainties: Discovery admits native self Spell Damage clauses, including conditional, school-specific and scripted declarations, under an explicit local structural policy. The66 identities are independent of executable coverage; the20 reference/grant/future-gain records remain recorded.

Next-minion cost matches positive unconsumed spell_damage ability presence in the original physical hand quote; native conditions/school restrictions are structural declarations rather than current board activation. Granted current copies qualify; removed abilities do not. Exact CN conditional/dynamic identity windows remain uncalibrated.
A historical public Sif report was found, but it is not proof of current CN behavior. Dynamic declaration policy remains local and no unknown candidate is silently removed.

Deck of Wonders creates five ordinary new Scroll of Wonder entities inside one existing semantic shuffle operation, with ordinary independent random insertion. Scroll random spell domain uses the complete actual bound ordinary collectible-spell pool across classes, not the84 Arcane reference.
Scrolls use existing drawn-cast random targeting/choices and replacement draws, with ordinary full-hand burn precedence. Exact CN rule edges and live version alignment remain deferred.
